purpose: Synthetic arithmetic correctness and shape/dataflow tests; inference prefill/decode only; not pretrained accuracy, software speed or silicon PPA.

cases.shrink: All channel dimensions divided by32; heads and FFN ratio retained; depth reduced.
D/F/dh divided by32; 7:1 grouped query ratio retained.
D/F/dh divided by32; Q total width64 != D32 deliberately retained.
D/Fe/dh divided by32; actual 128 experts and top8 retained.
D/F/full dh/linear dk,dv divided by32; head counts and convolution length retained; minimum 3:1 quartet depth.
Channel dimensions divided by32; 2:1 linear value/key heads, 256 experts/top8/shared expert and 3:1 quartet retained.

experiments.oracle: Causal full-prefix GQA vs token-at-a-time native Hkv cache; compare every token and state contents; Q/K supplied after normalization and RoPE.
Explicit repeated-KV softmax vs native grouped-head tiled online softmax; compare several chunk lengths, causal edges and nonmultiple tiles.
Whole SwiGLU vs intermediate-channel streaming gate/up/elementwise/down accumulation; verify exact parent input/output shape and numerical tolerance.
All-experts reference with topk mask vs token dispatch/weighted scatter; include all routes concentrated, no dropped tokens, normalized scores and always-on shared expert.
Direct recurrent delta update vs affine-prefix formulation and segmented continuation; compare outputs and final matrix state; depthwise causal convolution continuation separate.

boundary: Tiny dims preserve operator types and declared ratios, not accuracy or hardware utilization of a trained full checkpoint.
Whole-model RoPE variants, vision encoder, MTP/speculative decoding and end-to-end logits excluded initially.
Synthetic router loads do not establish learned dispatch distributions or MoE communication tails.
Training/backward/optimizer noted analytically only; no training execution.
